paragraphs.source_en: N ick moved to the fourth item on the list. “Okay, how are we doing with product brochures?” He directed the question at Mikey. “We’re all set.” Mikey’s attempt to avoid being smug was transparent. Nick was a little surprised. “Really?” Sensing that her peers didn’t quite believe her, Mikey reached down into her computer bag, retrieved a stack of glossy leaflets, and began passing them around the room. “This is scheduled to go to print next week.” The room was quiet as everyone scrutinized the design and read the copy. Kathryn could sense that most of them were pleased by the quality of the material. But Nick seemed uncomfortable. “Were you going to talk to me about this? Because some of the salespeople are out doing customer research for these brochures, and they’re going to be a little miffed when they find out that their input was not...”
